post_live_archive_surface_label: Example archived replay and ended-event posture for official voter-information media routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews archived replays, ended-event pages, recurring-event replay routes, and related post-live shells so finished official media remains subordinate to the current written/help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow current-answer or return path after the live moment ends.

reviewed_post_live_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether the specific archived replay stays visibly subordinate to the current written/help route once the live event has ended.
Reviewed whether a stable event page, recurring-event route, or 'latest video' state can silently change which archive the voter encounters.
Reviewed whether redirect, autoplay-next, playlist, or looping behaviors keep archival navigation distinct from the current official answer path.
Reviewed whether chat replay, comments, Q&A traces, or other social residue on the replay shell stay subordinate to the current written/help lane.

post_live_boundary_note: Archived replays, ended-event pages, and recurring-event replay routes are treated as archival/distribution surfaces rather than automatic proof that the controlling operational answer still lives on the media page.
archive_identity_note: If both a general event page and one or more specific archive URLs exist after the event ends, the service records which artifact was actually reviewed rather than assuming the event shell and archive are interchangeable.
post_event_routing_note: Redirects, autoplay-next, playlist behavior, and looping replay routes are reviewed so continuity after the event ends does not outrun the visibility of the current written/help route.
archived_interaction_boundary_note: If chat replay, comments, polls, or Q&A traces remain visible after the event ends, those interaction layers are treated as neighboring surfaces rather than proof that the replay shell itself is the office's durable help desk.
current_help_recovery_note: When a voter lands on a replay or ended-event shell, the route still points back to the current official page, notice, FAQ/help entry, or named office contact instead of pretending that the replay shell fully controls.
